[/center]-> adds brand new animal which doesn't replace any existing ones! It's also compatible with other mods adding hedgehogs.
-> [b]PYGMY HEDGEHOG[/b] is a small animal living in the Coop. Everyday it digs up either Mixed Seeds or Ancient Seeds, if your friendship level is 3 hearts or more!
-> different sprites for adults and babies, who mature after 3 days.
[center]
To install, extract the zip file and place the extracted folder in the mods folder of the game.
[steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods]
